u0000: Clean rest/final state: the siren is silent, the pot is not boiling, no slipped food awaits pickup, and no order has been taken. Monitor the shop; if a client is waiting at the counter, take the order, and otherwise wait for the next event.
u0001: A client order has been taken and the food is still at the raw/unprepared stage; the siren is silent, the pot is calm, and no food is loose. Next, get raw food from the pantry if not already carrying it, prepare it at the stove, then take it to the client and serve.
u0002: A client order is taken and the food is prepared and ready to serve; the siren is silent, the pot is calm, and no slip is pending. Next, carry the prepared food to the waiting client, face the client, and toggle to serve, returning to the clean state.
u0010: No order is taken, the siren is silent, and the pot is calm, but food has slipped out of the hands and lies on the floor. Immediate objective: pick up that food on the very next move; afterward resume watching for a client or other events.
u0011: A client order is taken, but the raw food has slipped and is lying on the floor; the siren is silent and the pot is calm. Immediate objective: pick up the fallen food on the next move, then prepare it at the stove and serve the waiting client.
u0012: A client order is taken and the prepared food has slipped onto the floor; the siren is silent and the pot is calm. Immediate objective: pick up the prepared food on the next move, then deliver it to the waiting client and serve.
u0100: The pot is boiling over; the siren is silent, no food has slipped, and no order is taken. Next, deal with the stove: if carrying food, put it down on an empty cell beside the stove, toggle the stove with empty hands to turn it down, then pick the load back up. If a client is waiting, take the order when the hazard is handled.
u0101: A client order is taken but the food is still raw/unprepared, and the pot is boiling; the siren is silent and no slip is pending. Next, turn the stove down, first putting any carried food down beside it and later retrieving it, then prepare the order at the stove and serve.
u0102: A client order is taken and the prepared food is ready, while the pot is boiling; the siren is silent and no slip is pending. If carrying the prepared food, put it on an empty cell beside the stove, turn the stove down, pick it back up, then serve the waiting client.
u0110: Food has slipped and awaits pickup while the pot is boiling; the siren is silent and no order is taken. Immediate objective: pick up the fallen food on the next move. Then, since the pot still boils, put the load down beside the stove, turn the stove down with empty hands, and pick it back up.
u0111: A client order is taken, the raw food has slipped, and the pot is boiling; the siren is silent. Immediate objective: pick up the fallen food on the next move. Then put it down beside the stove, turn the stove down, retrieve it, prepare it, and serve.
u0112: A client order is taken, the prepared food has slipped, and the pot is boiling; the siren is silent. Immediate objective: pick up the prepared food on the next move. Then put it down beside the stove, turn the stove down, pick it up again, and serve.
u1000: The siren is ringing; the pot is calm, no food has slipped, and no order is taken. Next, go to the siren switch and toggle it off; carrying food does not prevent this. Afterward return to the clean state and watch for clients.
u1001: A client order is taken and the food is still raw/unprepared while the siren rings; the pot is calm and no slip is pending. Next, silence the siren at the switch, even while carrying food, then fetch and prepare the order at the stove and serve.
u1002: A client order is taken and prepared food is ready while the siren rings; the pot is calm and no slip is pending. Next, go to the siren switch and turn it off, then deliver the prepared food to the client and serve.
u1010: The siren is ringing and slipped food is lying on the floor; the pot is calm and no order is taken. Immediate objective: pick up the fallen food on the next move. Then go to the siren switch and toggle it off, and resume client monitoring afterward.
u1011: A client order is taken, the raw food has slipped, and the siren is ringing; the pot is calm. Immediate objective: pick up the fallen food on the next move. Then silence the siren, prepare the food at the stove, and serve.
u1012: A client order is taken, the prepared food has slipped, and the siren is ringing; the pot is calm. Immediate objective: pick up the prepared food on the next move. Then silence the siren and serve the waiting client.
u1100: Both the siren and the pot are active, with no order taken and no slip pending. Next, clear the hazards: turn the siren off at the switch and turn the stove down. If carrying food, set it beside the stove before fixing the stove and pick it up again; carrying food is still fine at the siren switch.
u1101: A client order is taken and the food is still raw/unprepared while both the siren and pot are active; no slip is pending. Handle the hazards while advancing the order: use the stove, putting any load down and retrieving it to fix the boil, to prepare the food, and silence the siren, then serve.
u1102: A client order is taken and prepared food is ready while both the siren and pot are active; no slip is pending. If carrying the food, put it down beside the stove, turn the stove down, pick it back up, turn the siren off at the switch, and then serve the client.
u1110: Slipped food awaits pickup while both the siren and pot are active, with no order taken. Immediate objective: pick up the food on the next move. Then silence the siren and turn the stove down; if now carrying the load, put it down beside the stove for the fix and retrieve it afterward.
u1111: A client order is taken, the raw food has slipped, and both the siren and pot are active. Immediate objective: pick up the fallen food on the next move. Then silence the siren and, if carrying the food, put it down beside the stove, turn the stove down, retrieve it, prepare it, and serve.
u1112: A client order is taken, the prepared food has slipped, and both the siren and pot are active. Immediate objective: pick up the prepared food on the next move. Then silence the siren, put the food down beside the stove if needed, turn the stove down, retrieve it, and serve.
